purpose: Admit country-specific or regional advertising and commerce channels through an evidence contract without inventing availability, authorization, metrics or execution support.

grouping_policy.executable_requirement: Resolve one exact platform, country_site, account binding and execution identity before any live action.

evidence_record_contract.promotion_rule: A candidate stays unknown until current first-party evidence is captured; account-level availability stays blocked_owner_input until a tenant-scoped read-only receipt exists.

evaluation_cases.scenario: LinkedIn Ads is requested without captured first-party evidence
evaluation_cases.must: keep the channel unknown and draft an evidence plan

evaluation_cases.scenario: Yandex Direct is requested for a country
evaluation_cases.must: resolve current official country and account scope first

evaluation_cases.scenario: Rakuten advertising is mentioned in a forum
evaluation_cases.must: classify it as a candidate only
evaluation_cases.must_not: upgrade the forum claim to official fact

evaluation_cases.scenario: A channel is described as global
evaluation_cases.must: use GLOBAL only for research grouping
evaluation_cases.must_not: create a GLOBAL executable account route

evaluation_cases.scenario: A Southeast Asia plan is proposed
evaluation_cases.must: resolve one exact country and channel

evaluation_cases.scenario: A search result snippet shows a feature
evaluation_cases.must: open and capture the first-party page before promotion
record version, country, permission and expiry

evaluation_cases.scenario: A live read-only receipt exists for one account
evaluation_cases.must: scope it to the exact tenant, store and execution identity

evaluation_cases.scenario: A candidate SDK is found on GitHub
evaluation_cases.must: check registry, license, pin and security first

evaluation_cases.scenario: A local channel uses an unfamiliar metric name
evaluation_cases.must: record the platform definition and formula
evaluation_cases.must_not: map it to ROAS by name similarity

evaluation_cases.scenario: A payment method or currency is missing
A campaign draft passes local validation
A community operator case reports success

evaluation_cases.must: expire the old rule and recheck first-party evidence
